composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 27 years old, with dusty lavender hair in long relaxed waves gathered partly back with a wooden barrette. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Her beauty comes from violet-brown eyes, softly rounded cheekbones, elegant brows, and a bright natural smile. Dress her in an opaque white cap-sleeved cotton blouse with a high square neckline and a muted sage A-line midi skirt. She stands beside a dwarf pear tree, gently supporting a ripe pear on a low branch with one hand near her shoulder while the other holds a small wicker basket against her hip. No stretched arms or exaggerated twisting. Golden leaves, tiny white flowers, and a narrow orchard path create quiet depth. Soft peach dusk highlights her hair against cool green foliage. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
